- **Who:** Aryan Johari — graduate software engineer, Auckland, New Zealand
- **Site:** https://aryanjohari.arkhives.nz — curated project portfolio with narrative exhibits and live demos
- **Availability:** Seeking a graduate / junior software engineering role in Auckland from **September 2026**

## Philosophy

I build software that solves real problems — from ML research pipelines to privacy-aware APIs and WebGL front ends. I own the full stack: architecture, APIs, and deployment. AI accelerates delivery, but the design and architecture are mine. This portfolio is a curated project index, not a README dump. The home-page guide is the primary way to explore work and ask hiring questions.

- Production traffic, paying customers, or enterprise deployments for personal projects (ADA, GSTF, Background Studio, PII Gateway, Sound Visualiser, Tahi Pulse) unless explicitly verified in evidence
- GSTF as deployable deepfake detector or state-of-the-art forensic product (research thesis only)
- GSTF / Generator-Specific Temporal Forensics publication as **accepted**, **published**, camera-ready, DOI, volume/issue, or peer-reviewed acceptance — status is **under review** at Machine Vision and Applications (Springer) only until updated here
- Master's GPA on a /10 or /4.0 scale — always **7.667 / 9.0** (Unitec postgraduate)
- ADA as hosted SaaS or multi-tenant cloud service
- ADA embodied Pi / constitution / Tailscale HUD from `rewrite/v1-body` until merged to `main` and this index updated
- Background Studio Prism / still-image rewrite (`rewrite/v1-styling`) or stale primary routes `/lab` / `/story` as the product story

- Specialist Support: PPC management, automated backlink building, or massive global traffic (~97% NZ local)
- KRIL or Specialist scope beyond what employment evidence supports

- Cash handling / till / POS on **web or SWE CVs** (Specialist Support, KRIL, Koverify, fullstack variants) — those roles have no till evidence. Cash handling **is** allowed on the Lane A retail CV for the family-minimart role only

## Employment (narrative index)

Junior website developer at a Mumbai digital marketing firm, building and maintaining client sites (WordPress, React, Shopify) with ongoing performance and SEO updates.

Website developer for three in-house brands: solo WordPress/WooCommerce clothing-site ops (catalog, SEO, Paytm, performance) plus a MERN hotel-business web app.

## Projects on this site

Citeable metrics for all projects are in **Verified metrics** above. Project-specific guardrails below supplement global boundaries.

### background-studio (CV: image-editor)

Browser WebGL studio for animated hero backgrounds; live at image.arkhives.nz. Stack: React, TypeScript, Vite, Three.js, R3F, GLSL, Vitest

**Approved CV bullets:**

- Built a browser WebGL studio for designing animated hero backgrounds in real time; live at image.arkhives.nz with preset / StageRecipe JSON export
- Shipped Stage routes `/workspace`, `/studio`, and `/embed-demo` plus keyed in-memory Jobs API (`/api/v1/*`) for brand briefs and campaign packs
- Wrote a single-pass GLSL compositor for layered effects; 82 Vitest tests covering preset validation
- Implemented preset system v2 with validation, hydrate, and apply modes; 14 bundled background looks; optional Gemini brief/mood with keyword fallback

**Do not claim (project-specific):** OpenAI SDK usage (raw `fetch` only); multi-pass framebuffer; audio-reactive backgrounds; hosted durable Jobs API; `/lab` or `/story` as primary routes; Prism rewrite branch

### sound-visualiser

Browser-only audio-reactive WebGL visualiser; live at music.arkhives.nz. Stack: TypeScript, Three.js, Web Audio API, GLSL, Meyda, GSAP

**Approved CV bullets:**

- Built real-time audio-reactive WebGL visualiser mapping Meyda spectral features to cinematic 3D, live webcam, and acid feedback modes; live at music.arkhives.nz
- Implemented beat-sync PLL, ping-pong FBO temporal feedback, and frame-rate-independent audio smoothing across three visual modes
- Derived bass/mid/high band energies and mood weights from power spectrum; optional beat-quantized modulation when sync confidence is high
- Built glass-overlay UI for mode switching, Sync Auto/Off, demo track, file upload, and microphone input — all capture/analysis/rendering client-side

**Do not claim (project-specific):** Both demo tracks working (`huzur.mp3` missing); Meyda built-in spectralFlux; `VoidLayer` not wired; `new-ideas` branch work

### pii-gateway

Self-hosted PII sanitization gateway (FastAPI + Presidio). Stack: Python, FastAPI, Presidio, Docker, PostgreSQL, pytest

**Approved CV bullets:**

- Built an API that redacts personal data from free text and structured JSON before it leaves a system (Presidio + policy rules)
- Added scheduled batch ingest from PostgreSQL, CSV/JSON files, and S3-compatible storage; 33 pytest tests with CI
- Defined YAML/JSON policy schema for entity allowlists, structured field rules, and batch connector settings
- Packaged as Docker image with compose overlay; CI runs ruff, mypy, pytest on 3.11/3.12 plus Docker build

**Do not claim (project-specific):** External security audit; published container registry; full batch/S3/Postgres validation; multi-language PII or multi-tenant SaaS

### ada

Headless Python asyncio agent for local edge operator. Stack: Python, asyncio, SQLite, Gemini API, AWS S3, pytest

**Approved CV bullets:**

- Built a local AI agent for constrained edge hardware: chat, goals, and background work with SQLite persistence
- Automated ingest-to-publish workflows that push content to AWS S3 after quality checks; 531 pytest tests with GitHub Actions CI
- Implemented knowledge ingest pipelines (RSS, GSC, keywords) with graph-lite extraction and publish quality gates on cited facts
- Built CLI operator surface (`ada` chat, daemon, goals, workflows) with allowlisted tools and human approval gates for risky actions
- Knowledge search via SQLite FTS5 with optional embedding-backed lookup (env-gated; not a full vector-DB RAG platform)

**Do not claim (project-specific):** Full RAG/vector DB/MCP; in-process scheduler; Next.js ISR consumer; embeddings on by default; embodied Pi from `rewrite/v1-body`

### gstf

PyTorch Master's thesis on video-level deepfake generator attribution (not binary detection). Stack: Python, PyTorch, Docker, Grad-CAM

**Approved CV bullets:**

- Implemented Master's thesis PyTorch pipeline for video-level deepfake generator attribution using R(2+1)D, ArcFace metric learning, and EWC continual learning
- Achieved 86.67% held-out accuracy on FaceForensics++ with ArcFace; YAML-driven experiment runner with Grad-CAM attribution and Dockerised training
- Studied cross-domain adaptation (FF++→DFDM) via EWC, replay, and joint training; documented domain-shift failure modes (~34.6% zero-shot DFDM)
- Built modular training/eval CLI (`train`, `preprocess`, `evaluate`, `gradcam`, `umap`, `compute_fisher`) with reproducibility utilities

**Do not claim (project-specific):** Robust cross-domain attribution; face detection in baseline; legal admissibility; GitHub Actions CI; official conferral date

## Projects not on this site

### tahi-pulse (off-site)

Hackathon privacy check-in OS for small hospitality desks — session → Didit ID verify → webhook → tier allowlist → purge → min tx + KMS desk receipt. Built at Unitec AI for Good hackathon (6–8 Aug 2026). **Not in the portfolio carousel** — mention only if asked.

Stack: Vite, React, TypeScript, FastAPI, Mangum, AWS SAM, Didit IDV, KMS, Vercel

**Approved CV bullets:**

- Built a privacy check-in demo for small hospitality desks: desk session → Didit verify → webhook → tier allowlist → purge → min trust tx + KMS-signed desk receipt
- Shipped engineering blocks 1–5 (sessions, Didit integration, desk UI, KMS receipts); three merchant tiers with different disclosure rules (hotel/car vs age-only events)
- Deployed web on Vercel and API on AWS SAM (Lambda + DynamoDB) in ap-southeast-2; live demo at hackathon-ivory-rho.vercel.app

**Do not claim (project-specific):**

- Custom in-house Didit camera UI (uses Didit hosted verify)
- Durable production hardening beyond demo constraints (D5 incomplete)

## Guide routing FAQ

- **Who / site:** Aryan Johari, graduate SWE, Auckland. Curated portfolio; home guide is primary Q&A.
- **Hiring:** Graduate/junior SWE, Auckland, start Sept 2026. PSW 29 Aug 2026–29 Aug 2029, no sponsorship.
- **Full-stack:** background-studio, sound-visualiser. **Backend/API:** pii-gateway. **WebGL:** background-studio, sound-visualiser (live demos). **ML/thesis:** gstf (86.67% FF++ — verified only). **Agents/edge:** ada (local, not SaaS).
- **Demos:** Live on-site: background-studio, sound-visualiser. Exhibits only: ada, gstf, pii-gateway. Off-site: tahi-pulse (not in carousel).
- **Tenure:** Use tenureHints; approximate only. SEO + web dev roles listed.
- **GSTF:** Thesis research, not production detector. **Publication:** under review at Springer only — not accepted/published.
- **ADA:** Local edge agent, not hosted SaaS.
